ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 65:35 ratio of high-intensity white pixels on lateral lobes to low-intensity black pixels in the central and basal regions.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central low-intensity black region forming an inverted triangular shape from peduncle to notch; high-intensity white lobes with extensive stochastic black mottling at the transition zones; yellow-tinted pixel clusters localized in the mid-lateral white fields.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: V-shaped median notch with a calculated angle of approximately 45 degrees; depth is significant, penetrating approximately 1/6th of the vertical fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous fine-scale serration across both lobes; a distinct irregular macro-notch is visible on the right lobe trailing edge approximately 2/3 distance from the center.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bilateral symmetry with convex leading edges and a transition from concave to straight trajectory along the trailing edge towards the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense clusters of high-relief, calcified white circular pixels (barnacle colonies) on distal tips and trailing edges; a single isolated white circular scar is visible on the inner right black region.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct dark vertical linear pixel streaks on the left white lobe; faint horizontal parallel rake marks observed on the lower right black region.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Circular white-bordered lesion on the interior right lobe; heavy biological encrustation on fluke tips; irregular traumatic indentation on the distal trailing edge of the right lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Bilateral yellowish biological staining (diatom film) creating a color gradient on the high-intensity white surfaces.
